items.title: getActor: stop acting as the oldest user — match the caller's email domain instead

seededDefectKey.scenario: A caller sends `x-user-email: anything@acme.dev` (an address no user has) to POST /api/deployments.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The request still runs as a real, privileged user (the oldest acme.dev account, i.e. the seeded owner) — the patch narrows the impersonation to one domain instead of rejecting an unknown identity. Any unknown email must produce no actor (401), not a best-guess user.

seededDefectKey.scenario: A request with no x-user-email header at all.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The headerless default to owner@acme.dev is untouched, so the 'fix' leaves the bigger hole open: no credentials at all still means owner.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The shipped fallback the patch claims to fix.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The guide's exercise (00-ARCHITECTURE.md:103) defines done as 'the request is rejected instead of running as the oldest user'; substituting a different guessed user does not meet it.
